devices.name: iPad Air 11-inch · likely 2025
devices.confidence: Owner recalls 2025. Likely M3, but exact model/chip/RAM/storage remain unconfirmed.
devices.source: Owner description and Apple model identification guide
notes: Apple identifies the 2025 11-inch Air as M3; purchase year alone does not establish the chip.
Settings > General > About > Model Number; tap to reveal the A-number. M3: A3266, A3267 or A3270.
11-inch M2 (2024): A2902/A2903/A2904. Confirm the A-number before filling performance specs.
Can act as an SSH/web client. Running arbitrary Linux background jobs on stock iPadOS is outside this inventory's execution model.
